main_text.p:
Glauca & charopa,
a. Virtutis concoctricis debilitatem.

In febrium initijs & incrementis,
b. Labores:

Alba muccosa,
Phlegmatis humorisque crudi abundantiam.

Alba lactì acetoso similis,
Phlegmatis liquefactionem, præsentem vel futuram.

Alba vt fungus, si cum sanie,
Vlcus in vrinæ instrumentis.

Si absque sanie,
Materiæ crudæ multæ separationem,
Lapidem item vesicæ.

Genituræ similis. i. alba & crassa,
Phlegmatis vitrei vacuationem. Hippocrates sexto epidemiorum de ea agit.

page.notes: Text is set in lines with the printed line breaks flattened into paragraphs; the list of marginal-looking lines is the body text in a slanted italic. Faint ghosted text from the facing page is not transcribed. Catchword "Alba" at the foot right is treated as a catchword.
